title: Agent-to-Agent Communication
summary: This module enables secure and structured delegation of tasks and information exchange between different AI agents. It provides authentication, update mechanisms, and utilities to facilitate collaborative workflows and extend agent capabilities.

nodes.label: Core Delegation Logic
nodes.title: A2A Core Delegation
nodes.description: Manages the primary logic for agents to delegate tasks and initiate workflows with other agents, handling both synchronous and asynchronous calls.

nodes.label: Authentication & Security
nodes.title: A2A Authentication
nodes.description: Provides various client and server-side authentication schemes (API keys, OAuth2, tokens) to secure Agent-to-Agent communication channels.

nodes.label: Update Mechanisms & Extensions
nodes.title: A2A Updates & Extensions
nodes.description: Handles different methods for receiving updates (polling, streaming, push notifications) and integrates A2UI for declarative user interface generation.

nodes.label: Configuration & Utilities
nodes.title: A2A Configuration & Utilities
nodes.description: Offers essential functions for agent card management, gRPC interception, task cancellation monitoring, and general A2A configuration settings.

nodes.label: Initiating CrewAI Agent
nodes.title: CrewAI Agent
nodes.description: A CrewAI agent that initiates delegation requests to other agents or services via the A2A module.

nodes.label: Receiving Remote Agent
nodes.title: Remote Agent/Service
nodes.description: An external agent or service that receives and processes delegated tasks or requests from a CrewAI agent.

nodes.label: CrewAI Event Bus
nodes.title: CrewAI Event Bus
nodes.description: The central messaging system within CrewAI for emitting and handling various events, including those related to A2A communication.

groups.label: Core A2A Functionality
groups.title: Core Agent-to-Agent Logic
groups.description: Encapsulates the central mechanisms for agents to delegate tasks and orchestrate workflows with other agents.

groups.label: A2A Supporting Services
groups.title: A2A Infrastructure Services
groups.description: Provides essential services like secure communication, update management, extensions, and configuration utilities for robust A2A operations.

groups.label: External Interactions
groups.title: External System Interfaces
groups.description: Represents the external entities and internal CrewAI systems that interact with the Agent-to-Agent communication module.
